connector.name: Doriku
connector.registryDescription: Shared control plane for AI coding agents - tasks, memory, decisions, file locks. 12 tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.doriku.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.doriku, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for API authentication (format: Bearer drk_*)
